name: 4NE-1
summary: The humanoid from Germany's NEURA Robotics, a company that builds its own actuators, sensors and 'cognitive' control stack and targets both industrial and household work. NEURA opened pre-orders and has promoted an ecosystem approach with an app store and partners; a revised 4NE-1 was shown in 2025. 4NE1 Gen 4 (October 2026, opened alongside TUM's RoboGym in Munich) is 20% lighter, with upgraded hands, limb-level reflexes and NEURA's Neuron AI, and is being prepared for series production.
notable: Leading European entrant in the general-purpose humanoid race
Vertically integrated actuators, touch sensing and AI stack

sources.title: NEURA Unveils Lighter 4NE1 Gen 4 — Humanoids Daily
